note: Showcase scenarios for the GitHub Pages demo (site/). Every clip is Kokoro TTS (Apache-2.0 voices): eval sets or scripts/pages/make_audio.py. No user recordings.

scenarios.title: A plain fact
scenarios.blurb: The topic comes first, the question last. Free lookups start on the topic word.

scenarios.title: Live data
scenarios.text: what's the weather gonna be like in Chicago tomorrow
scenarios.blurb: Weather is a free live card, not a paid web search.

scenarios.title: Follow-up chain
turns: who is the president of usa
scenarios.blurb: "The old one" only makes sense with the first answer in memory.

scenarios.title: Topic switch
turns: okay, good restaurants in San Jose
scenarios.blurb: A new topic drops the old context instead of searching "Paris restaurants".

scenarios.title: Self-correction
scenarios.text: what's the capital of Canada, actually make that Turkey
scenarios.blurb: The Canada search is cancelled the moment the speaker corrects.

scenarios.title: Two questions in one
scenarios.text: who founded Nvidia and when was it founded
scenarios.blurb: The planner splits it into two lookups and answers both.

scenarios.title: Search while you type
scenarios.blurb: Typed questions go through the same pipeline: lookups start on finished words, Enter is the endpoint.

scenarios.title: Open mic chatter
turns: honey, did you remember to feed the dog
how long should I roast a whole chicken
scenarios.blurb: A remark to someone in the room is heard, not searched. Only the question to Onset is answered.

scenarios.title: Ask the Tavily docs
scenarios.text: how many credits does an advanced search cost on Tavily
scenarios.blurb: Answered from the Tavily docs read once into the local index: zero paid calls.

scenarios.title: Race vs Baseline
scenarios.text: okay so my kid asked me this, and I didn't know, why is the sky blue
scenarios.blurb: Same ear, same search, same answer model. Only when the search starts differs.

scenarios.title: Price right now
scenarios.text: how much is one Bitcoin worth right now in US dollars
scenarios.blurb: A live price, labelled with when it was fetched.
